text.p: Stocks of peanuts held in U.S. commercial storage on August 31 totaled 505 million lbs of equivalent farmer stock, down from 959 billion lbs a year ago, the U.S. Agriculture Department said.
End-August stocks included 44.358 million lbs of farmer stock versus 17.85 million lbs a year ago.
Shelled peanuts totaled 443.26 million lbs of equivalent farmer stock versus 887.29 billion lbs a year ago. July roasting stocks totaled 17.56 million lbs versus 53.87 million a year ago.
There were no Commodity Credit Corporation uncommitted stocks in August versus none a year earlier, USDA said.
End-August stocks of shelled peanuts included 584.5 million lbs of edible grades and 82.59 million lbs of oil stock.
August millings totaled 31.77 million lbs, including 480,000 lbs of Virginia peanuts, 31.3 million lbs of runners and no Spanish-type peanuts.
Shelled peanuts crushed for oil, cake and meal totaled 61.9 million lbs, the department said.
